answer: Random attention liveness escrow: identities must answer randomized challenges at irregular intervals, proving sustained attention, not one-time presence. Missed checks freeze permissions until a contiguous streak is rebuilt; schedules drift like a glacier so precomputed replies expire. Dormant accounts earn no age credit, closing karst-like stockpiles. A registration jetty delays burst signups until attention debt clears. An attacker pays continuous watcher attention per identity, scaled across every maintained account.
